verses.text: “My spirit is worn out. My days have burned out, and the grave is ready for me.
I’m surrounded by people who mock me. I can’t look away from the way they provoke me.
“Put up a pledge for me. Be my guarantor before yourself. Who else will shake hands on my behalf?
You’ve kept their hearts from understanding, so you won’t lift them up.
If someone turns in their friends for a share of the plunder, even their children’s eyes will fail.
“But he’s made my name a byword among the people. They spit in my face.
My eyes have gone dim with grief. My whole body is barely a shadow.
Upright people will be stunned at this. The innocent will rise up against the godless.
Still, those who are righteous will stick to their path, and those with clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.
But come on back, all of you. I won’t find a single wise person among you.
My days are gone. My plans are shattered, along with the hopes I held in my heart.
They turn night into day, saying, ‘The light is close,’ even with darkness right in front of them.
If I look to Sheol as my home and spread out my bed in the dark,
if I call decay ‘my father’ and say to the worm, ‘My mother, my sister,’
then where’s my hope? Who can even see it?
Will it go down with me to the gates of Sheol? Will we go down into the dust together?”
